---
title: "`r params$title`"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: false
    theme: flatly
params:
  run: NULL
  title: "Lab data QC report"
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
options(knitr.kable.NA = "") # blank deliveries show as blank, not "NA"
run <- params$run
findings <- run$findings
rec <- run$reconciliation

# kable() escapes HTML, so results such as "<0.20" display literally
tbl <- function(df, ...) {
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(knitr::asis_output("<p><em>None.</em></p>"))
  knitr::kable(df, format = "html", row.names = FALSE, escape = TRUE,
               table.attr = 'class="table table-condensed table-striped"', ...)
}
finding_cols <- c("check", "vendor", "subject_id", "visit", "test_code",
                  "result_raw", "unit_raw", "detail", "source_file", "source_line")
count_by <- function(x, levels) {
  counts <- table(factor(x, levels = levels))
  data.frame(value = names(counts), n = as.vector(counts))
}
```

Generated `r format(run$run_info$run_at, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z")` by biomarkerqc
`r run$run_info$package_version` (`r run$run_info$r_version`).

## Summary

```{r summary-cards, results = "asis"}
sev <- table(factor(findings$severity, levels = c("error", "warning", "info")))
cat(sprintf(
  '<div class="summary-grid">
  <div><b>%d</b>rows ingested</div>
  <div class="error"><b>%d</b>errors</div>
  <div class="warning"><b>%d</b>warnings</div>
  <div class="info"><b>%d</b>info</div>
  <div><b>%s</b>shared samples need review</div>
</div>',
  nrow(run$labs), sev[["error"]], sev[["warning"]], sev[["info"]],
  if (is.null(rec)) "n/a" else sum(rec$status != "agree")
))
```

### Input files

Checksums identify the exact files that were checked. If a file's MD5 no longer
matches, it has changed since this report was produced.

```{r inputs}
log <- run$ingest_log
log$ingested_at <- format(log$ingested_at, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
tbl(log)
```

### Findings by check

```{r by-check}
checks <- run$settings$checks
checks$findings <- as.vector(table(factor(findings$check, levels = checks$check)))
tbl(checks[, c("check", "severity", "findings", "description")])
```

## Errors

Results that cannot be used as delivered.

```{r errors}
tbl(findings[findings$severity == "error", finding_cols])
```

## Warnings

Incomplete or redundant data.

```{r warnings}
tbl(findings[findings$severity == "warning", finding_cols])
```

## Info

```{r info}
tbl(findings[findings$severity == "info", finding_cols])
```

## Cross-vendor reconciliation

```{r rec-intro, results = "asis"}
if (is.null(rec)) {
  cat("Only one vendor was ingested, so there was nothing to reconcile.")
} else {
  v <- attr(rec, "vendors")
  cat(sprintf(
    "Compared %d samples reported by both vendor %s (`_a`) and vendor %s (`_b`).
Results agree when their relative difference is at most %s%%.",
    nrow(rec), v[1], v[2], 100 * run$settings$tolerance
  ))
}
```

```{r rec-status}
if (!is.null(rec)) {
  tbl(count_by(rec$status, c("agree", "discrepant", "censored", "date_mismatch",
                             "ambiguous", "unusable")),
      col.names = c("status", "samples"))
}
```

### Samples needing review

```{r rec-review}
if (!is.null(rec)) {
  review <- rec[rec$status != "agree", ]
  review$result_a <- signif(review$result_a, 4)
  review$result_b <- signif(review$result_b, 4)
  review$rel_diff <- sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * review$rel_diff)
  tbl(review)
}
```

## Settings used

### Unit conversion rules

`approved value = value x multiplier + offset`

```{r rules}
rules <- run$settings$rules
rules$multiplier <- signif(rules$multiplier, 6)
tbl(rules)
```

### Unit spelling synonyms

Matching is case-insensitive.

```{r synonyms}
syn <- run$settings$synonyms
tbl(data.frame(delivered = names(syn), treated_as = unname(syn)))
```

### Plausibility limits

In each test's approved unit.

```{r limits}
tbl(run$settings$limits)
```
